content: Regarding the RCV1 dataset, our results consider only the headline content for training, while the refereed works consider both the news headline and message body. The reason for training using only the headlines is that both tasks are learnt with the sole purpose of transferring the sentence encoders to our main volatility prediction task, whose textual input is restricted to headlines.
